headline: Pro Evolution Soccer
title: Pro Evolution Soccer Facts | PES vs FIFA | Classic Games
video_script: Pro Evolution Soccer, or PES, is made by Konami and is called Winning Eleven in Japan. The PES name debuted in two thousand one, and for years it battled EA Sports FIFA every autumn. Licences were its weak spot, so many teams had made up names. In two thousand twenty one, Konami dropped the PES name and launched free to play eFootball. Were you a PES player or a FIFA player? Comment below!
description: Pro Evolution Soccer by Konami: known as Winning Eleven in Japan, PES name debuted in 2001, replaced by free to play eFootball in 2021.
